rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for transferring goods or services in exchange for money.

example.jyutping: ngo5 hai2 mong5 dim3 maai6 sau2 gung1 zou6

rows.note: Use this for whether goods successfully find a buyer, especially in expressions like 賣唔出.

example.english: This cake finally manages to sell.
example.jyutping: ni1 fun2 daan6 gou1 zung1 jyu1 maai6 ceot1 laa3

rows.note: Use this when promoting a product or service rather than describing the completed exchange of money for it.

example.english: The staff sell the new phone by promoting its features.
example.traditional: 員工靠介紹功能嚟推銷部新手機。
example.jyutping: jyun4 gung1 kaau3 gaai3 siu6 gung1 nang4 lei4 teoi1 siu1 bou6 san1 sau2 gei1

rows.note: Use this when “selling” a viewpoint means persuading someone to accept it.

example.english: You need to sell me on the idea that this plan will really work.
example.traditional: 你要先說服我呢個方案真係可行。
example.jyutping: nei5 jiu3 sin1 syut3 fuk6 ngo5 ni1 go3 fong1 on3 zan1 hai6 ho2 hang4
